system.description:
Like a bar of steel, like a mountain, you stand immutable against all harm; only truly monumental and sustained force can ever destroy you, and once the storm has passed you rise from the chaos unscathed.

At any point during a turn you may declare Aegis by expending one permanent Willpower Trait or three permanent Physical Traits (these may later be re-purchased with Experience Traits). Declaring it immediately revokes all damage you have suffered that turn and grants you immunity to further damage for the rest of the turn. You may even declare Aegis after being "killed," ignoring the killing blow and any other injury taken in the same turn — but you must do so during that same turn, as once a new turn begins no previous damage can be revoked. Use of Aegis is reflexive and costs no action.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
